ba.barrier.name: Barrier
ba.barrier.description: Absorbs a certain amount of damage.

ba.berserk.name: Tenacity
ba.berserk.description: Increases stats proportionally based on lost HP, reaching the maximum bonus once a certain percentage has been lost (only the strongest effect of this type applies)

ba.buffres.name: Status Resistance
ba.buffres.description: <$ba.stun>Stun</>, <$ba.cold>Cold</>, and <$ba.frozen>Frozen</> durations halved; <$ba.palsy>Paralysis</> loses 1 stack every 5s (does not stack with the same effect)

ba.camou.name: Camouflage
ba.camou.description: Prevents being targeted by normal enemy attacks if the unit is not blocking (but will still take Splash damage)

ba.charged.name: Charged
ba.charged.description: Can continue recovering SP after reaching the maximum. When SP reaches double the maximum, enters Charged state. Skills have additional effects when activated in Charged state (All SP will be consumed whenever the skill is activated)

ba.cold.name: Cold
ba.cold.description: Reduces ASPD by 30 and causes subsequent applications of the Cold status during the debuff duration to inflict <$ba.frozen>Frozen</>

ba.costlowerbound.name: DP Lower Limit
ba.costlowerbound.description: DP can drop below the DP Lower Limit; when DP is below 0, natural DP regeneration rate -50%

ba.dmgresistance.name: Damage Reduction
ba.dmgresistance.description: Reduces incoming damage by a fixed amount (only the strongest effect of this type applies)

ba.dt.apoptosis.name: Necrosis
ba.dt.apoptosis.description: After Necrosis reaches 1000, the affected unit cannot use skills for 15 seconds and every second loses 1 SP and takes 100 Arts damage

ba.dt.apoptosis2.name: Necrosis - Ally
ba.dt.apoptosis2.description: Explodes when at max (1000 for Normal and Elite, 2000 for Leaders), inflicting 50%<$ba.weaken>Enfeeble</> that gradually recovers, and dealing 800 Elemental Damage per second. 15s cooldown.

ba.dt.burning.name: Burn
ba.dt.burning.description: After Burn reaches 1000, the affected unit has its RES reduced by 20 for 10 seconds and takes 1200 Arts damage

ba.dt.burning2.name: Burn - Ally
ba.dt.burning2.description: Explodes when at max (1000 for Normal and Elite, 2000 for Leaders), dealing 7000 Elemental Damage and temporarily inflicting -20 RES. 10s cooldown.

ba.dt.erosion.name: Corrosion
ba.dt.erosion.description: After Corrosion reaches 1000, the affected unit has its DEF permanently reduced by 100 and takes 800 Physical damage

ba.dt.erosion2.name: Corrosion - Ally
ba.dt.erosion2.description: Explodes when at max (1000 for Normal and Elite, 2000 for Leaders), dealing 5000 Elemental Damage and permanently reducing DEF by 120 (stacks). 8s cooldown.

ba.dt.neural.name: Nervous Impairment
ba.dt.neural.description: After Nervous Impairment reaches 1000, the affected unit takes 1000 True damage and is <$ba.stun>Stunned</> for 10s

ba.dt.neural2.name: Nervous Impairment - Ally
ba.dt.neural2.description: Explodes when at max (1000 for Normal and Elite, 2000 for Leaders), dealing 6000 Elemental Damage and inflicting 3 stacks of <$ba.palsy>Paralysis</>. 10s cooldown.

ba.dying.name: Critically Wounded
ba.dying.description: Movement Speed reduced, cannot be blocked, dies after 10s, restores SP to the attacker when defeated.

ba.elementfragile.name: Elemental Fragility
ba.elementfragile.description: Amplifies all Elemental Damage taken by the corresponding amount (only the strongest effect of this type applies)

ba.fragile.name: Fragile
ba.fragile.description: Amplifies all Physical, Arts, and True damage taken by the corresponding amount (only the strongest effect of this type applies)

ba.frozen.name: Frozen
ba.frozen.description: Unable to move, attack, or use skills (inflicted through the <$ba.cold>Cold</> status); When enemies are frozen, RES -15

ba.inspire.name: Inspiration
ba.inspire.description: Increases base stats (only the strongest effect of this type applies for each stat)

ba.invisible.name: Invisible
ba.invisible.description: Prevents being targeted by enemy attacks if the unit is not blocking

ba.laiosteam.name: Laios's Party
ba.laiosteam.description: Includes Marcille, Senshi, Laios, and Chilchuck

ba.levitate.name: Levitate
ba.levitate.description: Target becomes aerial and cannot move, attack, or use skills. Duration halved if Weight is greater than 3.

ba.liftoff.name: Take Off
ba.liftoff.description: Cannot block ground enemies and will not be attacked by them; can block flying enemies

ba.magicfragile.name: Arts Fragility
ba.magicfragile.description: Amplifies all Arts damage taken by the corresponding amount (only the strongest effect of this type applies)

ba.magicpoint.name: Mana
ba.magicpoint.description: A special form of SP that persists throughout battle

ba.mujica.name: Ave Mujica
ba.mujica.description: Includes Sakiko Togawa, Umiri Yahata, Uika Misumi, Nyamu Yūtenji, Mutsumi Wakaba

ba.palsy.name: Paralysis
ba.palsy.description: Each stack of Paralysis can interrupt an enemy when it attempts to perform a normal attack, max 3 stacks; Paralysis has unlimited duration when not consumed, but units with status resistance lose 1 stack every 5s

ba.permanentatk.name: Continuously Attack
ba.permanentatk.description: Continuously attacks, regardless of whether there is a target within Attack Range

ba.physhield.name: Physical Shield
ba.physhield.description: Blocks 1 instance of Physical damage per layer of Physical Shield

ba.physicfragile.name: Physical Fragility
ba.physicfragile.description: Amplifies all Physical damage taken by the corresponding amount (only the strongest effect of this type applies)

ba.protect.name: Sanctuary
ba.protect.description: Reduces incoming Physical and Arts damage by the corresponding amount (only the strongest effect of this type applies)

ba.shield.name: Shield
ba.shield.description: Blocks 1 instance of damage per layer of Shield

ba.sleep.name: Sleep
ba.sleep.description: Invulnerable and unable to take any actions

ba.steal.name: Steal
ba.steal.description: Reduces the target's base stats while increasing own. The reduction and increase in stats cannot exceed the specified upper limit (only the strongest effect of this type applies)

ba.strong.name: Vigor
ba.strong.description: Increases stats when HP is above a certain percentage (only the strongest effect of this type applies)

ba.stun.name: Stun
ba.stun.description: Unable to move, block, attack, or use skills

ba.tremble.name: Frighten
ba.tremble.description: Cannot perform normal attacks when blocked

ba.weaken.name: Enfeeble
ba.weaken.description: Reduces the target's ATK by the corresponding amount (only the strongest effect with this name applies)

ba.weightless.name: Weightless
ba.weightless.description: Weight reduced by 1 level (effects of the same name do not stack)
